note: This is the Sky1 arm64 DEFAULT and installer boot kernel under the unified 7.3 policy (operator 2026-10-05): there is no edge channel and assets/kernel/mainline points at this r286 build. r286 = r285 + 0012 (sky1-ncz-dptx-aux-wedge-recovery: on trilin DP AUX -EBUSY exhaustion the driver resets the AUX/PHY and retries, bounded by aux_recover_max, and recovers on the core_on [already ready] path). This is the MS-R1 DisplayPort black-screen fix the operator accepted on .66 (2026-10-11). The change touches only drivers/gpu/drm/cix/dptx/trilin_dptx.c and adds only static functions: KVER is unchanged and every exported-symbol CRC is unchanged, so the committed r285 accelerator overlays remain ABI-compatible (verified: verify-overlay-modversions against r286 Module.symvers = 0 CRC mismatches) and are NOT re-mirrored. The PCIe default is unchanged (sky1_pcie_native=off pcie_pnp_en). The rescue entry boots this same kernel with the arm64 accelerator blacklist. Replaced by 7.3.0 final later.
